status: ASSUMPTION A9d supplier-backed bridge lower-bound screen; NOT RUN

onsemi_nxv08h400xt1.supplier_description: 80 V APM17-MDC two-phase MOSFET module; supplier permits combining both phase outputs as one half bridge for 48 V inverter/traction use
onsemi_nxv08h400xt1.sharing_assumption: Within each module I assume the supplier-described combined half bridge shares phase current equally between its two parallel phase paths. Parallel modules also share equally. This makes a necessary lower-bound screen, not a current-sharing design.

infineon_ipt015n10n5.supplier_description: 100 V OptiMOS 5 TOLL MOSFET for 48-72 V systems
infineon_ipt015n10n5.sharing_assumption: Parallel discrete devices share equally and only the published 25 C maximum Rds(on) is used. Package, busbar and contact resistance are absent, so this is a lower bound.

rules.electronics_loss_budget: Undo the 0.97 generic inverter-efficiency factor in A9b. Real bridge conduction plus every omitted electrical loss must fit between that non-inverter energy and the unchanged 900/1500 J system caps.
rules.three_phase_conduction: At each face, three phase RMS currents contribute I_rms^2*Rpath. Sum over four face channels using the committed A9 current-squared invariant and multiply by shot time.
rules.onsemi_combined_path: For one supplier-described combined half bridge, use half the maximum high path and half the maximum low path, then average them over phase-current polarity. Divide again by the number of parallel modules per phase.
rules.infineon_path: Use published maximum 25 C Rds(on) divided by equal-sharing device count per switch.
rules.no_switching_loss_credit: Switching, gate-drive, selector, capacitor ESR, busbar, cable, connector and cooling losses are reported as the remaining budget; they are not guessed.
